claims.text: Trismus: ketorolac or ibuprofen for analgesia
claims.quote: Pain control: If the patient has trismus, anti-inflammatory medications like ketorolac or ibuprofen can provide analgesia.

claims.text: Severe pain: opioids may be needed
claims.quote: Opioids may be necessary for severe pain.
Intravenous fluids: Intravenous fluids are typically necessary because most patients with peritonsillar abscesses will present with dehydration due to reduced oral intake from odynophagia.
